walkthrough.visible_context: The broom bundle is brought back up and held near the newly placed nail.
walkthrough.utterance: Test the broom against the nail to check alignment.

walkthrough.visible_context: The broom is now on the nail but hangs at a slight angle.
walkthrough.utterance: Straighten it—it's hanging tilted.
walkthrough.timing_rationale: The loop has caught but the broom is angled, so correcting orientation now avoids leaving it crooked.

walkthrough.visible_context: The broom is vertical but the bristles brush against the wall.

walkthrough.timing_rationale: The broom is nearly set but the bristles touch the wall, so a small alignment fix completes a clean hang.

walkthrough.visible_context: The hand examines the leather bindings near the top of the handle.
walkthrough.utterance: Make sure the top binding holds the nail.

walkthrough.visible_context: The hand holds the top of the broom against the upper door-frame corner after the tug.
walkthrough.utterance: Let it settle flat against the wall.
walkthrough.timing_rationale: The broom is being adjusted to rest flush, so guiding it to settle settles the final position.

walkthrough.visible_context: The camera steps back and the broom hangs against the wall beside the door.

walkthrough.timing_rationale: The broom is mounted and the viewpoint widens, so a visual check from a short distance is the last meaningful step.

walkthrough.visible_context: The user's hand reaches in to nudge the broom and adjust its lean beside the frame.

walkthrough.timing_rationale: The user is fine-tuning the tilt, so a concise cue supports the correction while it is underway.

walkthrough.visible_context: The broom hangs vertically and stable in the corner beside the door, and the view shows it fully mounted.
walkthrough.utterance: You're set—the broom's hanging securely.

examples.title: 36916ea54b5c1134: Origami heart & message (HomeDIY gift) — 22 agent events (19 intervene, 1 confirm, 1 observe, 1 complete), 4 silent intervals

timeline.text: HomeDIY
Lay the yellow paper flat and square with one corner pointing at you.
Fold the bottom corner up to meet the top corner, making a triangle.
Crease that diagonal fold firmly with your thumb.
Fold the bottom-left corner up toward the top point.
Now fold the bottom-right corner up to match the left.
The user is smoothly creasing the matched side folds without needing guidance.
Press both side creases flat so they stay in place.
Turn the paper over so the folds face the table.
Fold the top points down toward the center line.
Fold in the two side corners to taper the bottom of the heart.
The user is executing the symmetric taper folds correctly and steadily.
Fold the whole shape in half along the middle.
Pinch the center crease to make it sharp.
Gently open the top to separate the heart's two peaks.
Shape the two top points so they're even.
Press the whole heart flat to lock in the folds.
The user is carefully pressing the heart flat, a self-correcting action.
Narrow the bottom tip just a little for a cleaner point.
[confirm] That's it — that's your heart.
Pick up the black marker to write your message.
Write your message in the center of the heart.
Hold the heart flat with your other hand while you write.
[observe] Take your time — there's no rush finishing the last word.
Let the ink dry for a second before you fold it away.
The user finishes the message and sets the marker down without further help needed.
[complete] All done — your heart and message are ready.

walkthrough.visible_context: The paper is opening into a heart silhouette with two lobes at the top.
walkthrough.utterance: Shape the two top points so they're even.

walkthrough.visible_context: The heart silhouette is formed but the folds are loose.
walkthrough.utterance: Press the whole heart flat to lock in the folds.

walkthrough.visible_context: The heart is flat; the bottom point looks a little wide.
walkthrough.utterance: Narrow the bottom tip just a little for a cleaner point.
walkthrough.timing_rationale: Refining the bottom tip improves the heart's look before it's finished.

walkthrough.visible_context: The heart is complete and evenly shaped on the table.
walkthrough.utterance: That's it — that's your heart.

walkthrough.timing_rationale: The writing is going well; a light reassurance keeps it neat without interrupting.

walkthrough.visible_context: The user is finishing the final letter and the message is nearly done.

walkthrough.timing_rationale: Preventing a smudge on the finished message as the user prepares to set the marker down.

walkthrough.visible_context: The marker is set down and the finished heart with the message is resting on the table.
walkthrough.utterance: All done — your heart and message are ready.
walkthrough.timing_rationale: The task is visibly complete; a short closing message is appropriate.
